package.name: aeropact_baselines
package.description: Centralised baseline (05 section 5.2): a global planner on a hub that assigns jobs to drones over a long-range uplink. With the hub alive it is the efficiency upper bound (central_full); killing the hub (kill_service) gives central_hub_loss. Decentralised baselines (greedy_nearest, cbba_plain) are coordinator modes in aeropact_agent.
